name: Rahul Verma
review_text: Shows potential but inconsistent delivery. Has good ideas but struggles to drive them to completion independently. Colleagues find them easy to work with.

name: Vikram Nair
review_text: Consistently delivers high quality work and has led two successful product launches. Proactively mentors junior engineers and drives technical decisions independently.

name: Sneha Rao
review_text: Strong communicator who keeps the team aligned. Delivers on time but rarely takes initiative beyond assigned scope. Reliable but not yet showing Principal-level ownership.

name: Arjun Mehta
review_text: Exceptional technical depth. Redesigned the data pipeline reducing costs by 40%. Already influencing architecture decisions across two teams.

name: Fatima Sheikh
review_text: Solid performer with good technical skills. Work is reliable but feedback from peers suggests she defers too often to senior engineers rather than driving her own solutions.

name: Rohan Desai
review_text: Good team player but struggles with ambiguous problem statements. Needs more guidance than expected at this level. Has potential but not yet ready for Principal.

name: Ananya Krishnan
review_text: Led the migration of authentication service with zero incidents. Highly respected by peers and has started driving quarterly planning. A clear Principal-level contributor.

name: Imran Siddiqui
review_text: Technically competent but review feedback indicates difficulty in cross-team collaboration. Delivery is consistent within his own scope but influence beyond his team is limited.

name: Pooja Iyer
review_text: Hardworking and dependable. Completes all assigned tasks but has not yet demonstrated the strategic thinking or cross-functional leadership expected at Principal level.

name: Karthik Subramanian
review_text: Outstanding quarter. Delivered three major features ahead of schedule, mentored two junior engineers to promotion, and authored the team engineering standards doc adopted org-wide.
